nodes.name: EL NINO JARVIS Cyberpunk.html
nodes.summary: Standalone single-file cyberpunk/synthwave themed UI variant of the JARVIS dev_graph explorer, featuring a matrix digital-rain canvas, neon CSS palette with a pixel/matrix toggle, and an embedded JavaScript application for graph visualization.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-contained HTML with embedded CSS (extensive CSS custom properties for theming) and inline JavaScript; all styling and logic are co-located in one file, making this a monolithic UI prototype.

nodes.name: graph.json
nodes.summary: Exported projection of the dev_graph markdown as a JSON graph with 175 nodes and 1294 edges, consumed by the frontend index.html explorer and the backend /ask corpus for offline graph-intelligence queries.
nodes.languageNotes: Regenerated by export_graph_json.py from dev_graph markdown source — never hand-edited. Structured with top-level meta, nodes, and edges sections as described in the JARVIS projection chain.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Production offline graph explorer for the el_nino dev_graph, using Cytoscape.js to render nodes and edges from graph.json with search, type-filter, and node-detail panels in a dark monospace UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Standalone HTML file that loads Cytoscape from a local vendor path with CDN fallback; all application logic is inline JavaScript that fetches graph.json at runtime.
